organic_results.title: The energy balance model of obesity: beyond calories in, calories out
organic_results.snippet: While insulin stimulates lipogenesis and suppresses lipolysis biochemically, controlled human inpatient studies indicate energy expenditure and fat loss are governed predominantly by total caloric balance rather than insulin-mediated nutrient trapping.
